title: Sparkly camera
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <g fill='#FFF3B0'>
    <circle cx='30' cy='12' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='10' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='92' cy='44' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='8' cy='46' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='90' r='1.8'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='57' r='15' fill='none' stroke='#9FB4FF' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- lens mid -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='57' r='10.5' fill='#3FD0E8'/>
  <!-- lens glass -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='57' r='6.5' fill='#1B6E8C'/>
  <!-- lens shine -->
  <circle cx='46.5' cy='53.5' r='2.4' fill='#C8F6FF'/>

  <rect x='62' y='33' width='10' height='6' rx='2' fill='#FFD94A'/>

  <circle cx='30' cy='45' r='3' fill='#FF7A9C'/>
